blocks.text: The padded table has (R + 1)(C + 1) entries. Computing each non-sentinel entry once from constant neighboring state gives O(RC) preprocessing time, and retaining all entries gives O(RC) extra space. Each query performs four reads and a fixed three additions or subtractions, so query time is O(1).

Preprocessing is not O(R + C) because every one of RC cells contributes, O(RC log(RC)) adds sorting or logarithmic work that is absent, and O(R²C²) rescans rectangles that the recurrence avoids. Query time has no search, row/column scan, or matrix scan, rejecting the logarithmic, O(R + C), and O(RC) alternatives. Space is not O(1) or O(R + C) because one state is stored per row-column boundary pair, and not O(R²C²) because there is only one padded table.
